name: 91384 · Castaic, CA
findings: ZIP 91384 (Castaic) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91384 (Castaic) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
